    "## 1. Installation"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "0dbb4d10-640f-4cc8-ab88-9d8c63348d18",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### conda\n",
    "https://anaconda.org/bioconda/cytozip\n",
    "```shell\n",
    "mamba install -c wubinding -c bioconda cytozip\n",
    "# or\n",
    "conda install -c wubinding -c bioconda cytozip\n",
    "# \"-c wubinding\" is optional, which may be the latest version\n",
    "```\n",
    "\n",
    "### pip\n",
    "```shell\n",
    "# Prerequisites (one of):\n",
    "conda install -c bioconda htslib libdeflate samtools         # recommended\n",
    "# apt-get install libhts-dev libdeflate-dev samtools          # Debian/Ubuntu\n",
    "# brew install htslib libdeflate samtools                     # macOS\n",
    "pip install cytozip\n",
    "# or reinstall\n",
    "pip uninstall -y cytozip && pip install git+http://github.com/DingWB/cytozip\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {

    "## 2. Build reference cz file from a reference genome fasta file\n",
    "The reference holds the genome-wide (chrom, pos, strand, context) axis. Per-cell .cz then store only mc/cov and reuse the reference’s positions, cutting per-cell size by ~5×."
   ]
  },

    "### 4.1 convert stream input to cz with pipe"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "f614cd96-9c7b-4907-ac70-c89f1029d8db",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "usage: czip tocz [-h] -O OUTPUT [-I INPUT] [-F FORMATS] [-C COLUMNS]\n",
      "                 [-D CHUNK_DIMS] [-u USECOLS] [-d KEY_COLS] [-s SEP]\n",
      "                 [-c BATCH_SIZE] [--header HEADER] [--skiprows SKIPROWS]\n",
      "                 [-m MESSAGE] [-l LEVEL] [--delta_cols DELTA_COLS]\n",
      "\n",
      "options:\n",
      "  -h, --help            show this help message and exit\n",
      "  -O OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT\n",
      "                        output .cz file (default: None)\n",
      "  -I INPUT, --input INPUT\n",
      "                        input file (stdin if omitted) (default: None)\n",
      "  -F FORMATS, --formats FORMATS\n",
      "                        column formats, comma-separated (struct chars).\n",
      "                        Unsigned ints cap values: B=255, H=65535, I=2^32-1,\n",
      "                        Q=2^64-1; larger values are truncated (saturated) to\n",
      "                        the max. Default B for single-cell mc/cov saves space\n",
      "                        and is safe: counts >255 are usually repeat-region\n",
      "                        artifacts and downstream ALLCools DMR clips coverage\n",
      "                        to 50 anyway (default: ['B', 'B'])\n",
      "  -C COLUMNS, --columns COLUMNS\n",
      "                        column names, comma-separated (default: ['mc', 'cov'])\n",
      "  -D CHUNK_DIMS, --chunk_dims CHUNK_DIMS\n",
      "                        chunk-key (dimension) names, comma-separated (default:\n",
      "                        ['chrom'])\n",
      "  -u USECOLS, --usecols USECOLS\n",
      "                        column indices to pack, comma-separated (default: [4,\n",
      "                        5])\n",
      "  -d KEY_COLS, --key_cols KEY_COLS\n",
      "                        chunk-key column indices (default: [0])\n",
      "  -s SEP, --sep SEP     separator (default: )\n",
      "  -c BATCH_SIZE, --batch_size BATCH_SIZE\n",
      "                        rows per chunk (default: 5000)\n",
      "  --header HEADER       header row (default: None)\n",
      "  --skiprows SKIPROWS   rows to skip (default: 0)\n",
      "  -m MESSAGE, --message MESSAGE\n",
      "                        message stored in header (default: )\n",
      "  -l LEVEL, --level LEVEL\n",
      "                        compression level (default: 6)\n",
      "  --delta_cols DELTA_COLS\n",
      "                        comma-separated column names or indices (from\n",
      "                        parameter --columns) to store as in-block deltas\n",
      "                        (shrinks strictly-monotonic columns like pos; trades\n",
      "                        some query speed for size) (default: None)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "! czip tocz -h"
   ]
  },

    "### 4.2 allc to cz with reference cz as input"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "id": "56a1d563-5da4-4983-b843-49fb1682729c",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "usage: czip allc2cz [-h] -I INPUT -O OUTPUT [-r REFERENCE]\n",
      "                    [--missing_value MISSING_VALUE] [-F FORMATS] [-C COLUMNS]\n",
      "                    [-D CHUNK_DIMS] [-u USECOLS] [--ref_pos_col REF_POS_COL]\n",
      "                    [--allc_pos_col ALLC_POS_COL] [-s SEP] [--chroms CHROMS]\n",
      "                    [-c BATCH_SIZE] [--sort_col SORT_COL]\n",
      "                    [--delta_cols DELTA_COLS] [-j JOBS] [--pattern PATTERN]\n",
      "                    [--no_skip_existing]\n",
      "\n",
      "options:\n",
      "  -h, --help            show this help message and exit\n",
      "  -I INPUT, --input INPUT\n",
      "                        input allc.tsv.gz, OR a directory containing many\n",
      "                        allc.tsv.gz (batch mode: --output must be a directory)\n",
      "                        (default: None)\n",
      "  -O OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT\n",
      "                        output .cz file (single-file), or output directory\n",
      "                        (batch mode) (default: None)\n",
      "  -r REFERENCE, --reference REFERENCE\n",
      "                        reference .cz file (default: None)\n",
      "  --missing_value MISSING_VALUE\n",
      "                        missing value fill (default: [0, 0])\n",
      "  -F FORMATS, --formats FORMATS\n",
      "                        comma-separated column formats (struct chars). When\n",
      "                        reference is provided, we only need to pack mc and\n",
      "                        cov,['H', 'H'] is suggested for pseudobulk data (H is\n",
      "                        unsigned short integer, only 2 bytes),and ['B', 'B']\n",
      "                        is suggested for single cell data (B is unsigned char,\n",
      "                        only 1 byte).if reference is not provided, we also\n",
      "                        need to pack position (Q isrecommanded), in this case,\n",
      "                        formats should be ['Q','H','H']. (default: ['B', 'B'])\n",
      "  -C COLUMNS, --columns COLUMNS\n",
      "                        column names, comma-separated (default: ['mc', 'cov'])\n",
      "  -D CHUNK_DIMS, --chunk_dims CHUNK_DIMS\n",
      "                        chunk-key names, comma-separated (default: ['chrom'])\n",
      "  -u USECOLS, --usecols USECOLS\n",
      "                        column indices to pack (default: [4, 5])\n",
      "  --ref_pos_col REF_POS_COL\n",
      "                        position column index in reference (default: 0)\n",
      "  --allc_pos_col ALLC_POS_COL\n",
      "                        position column index in input (default: 1)\n",
      "  -s SEP, --sep SEP     separator (default: )\n",
      "  --chroms CHROMS       chrom order file (default: None)\n",
      "  -c BATCH_SIZE, --batch_size BATCH_SIZE\n",
      "                        rows per chunk (default: 5000)\n",
      "  --sort_col SORT_COL   column name or index to index via per-block\n",
      "                        first_coords (enables in-memory bisect for region\n",
      "                        queries). Auto-enabled on \"pos\" when no reference is\n",
      "                        used. (default: None)\n",
      "  --delta_cols DELTA_COLS\n",
      "                        comma-separated integer column names/indices to store\n",
      "                        as in-block deltas (default: None)\n",
      "  -j JOBS, --jobs JOBS  number of parallel workers in batch mode (input is a\n",
      "                        directory). Reference is decoded once and shared via\n",
      "                        fork copy-on-write, so memory cost is paid only once.\n",
      "                        (default: 1)\n",
      "  --pattern PATTERN     glob pattern for batch mode file discovery (default:\n",
      "                        *.allc.tsv.gz)\n",
      "  --no_skip_existing    in batch mode, do NOT skip files whose output already\n",
      "                        exists (default: False)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "! czip allc2cz -h"
   ]

    "All mismatches arise because cytozip clips mc and cov to a maximum of 255, since single-cell data is stored using the 1-byte unsigned integer format (B) by default."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "cbd4bf52-3c9a-4275-aa96-9c6d8eb91c8a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 7.4 Compare .cz converted .allc.tsv.gz and ALLCools generated .allc.tsv.gz"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 22,
   "id": "caae6c27-87d2-47f5-ac63-fca12bc4b8d4",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "usage: czip compare_allc [-h] -a ALLC1 -b ALLC2 [--keep_zero_cov]\n",
      "                         [--dtype {B,H,I,Q,None}] [-O OUTPUT] [--sep SEP]\n",
      "\n",
      "options:\n",
      "  -h, --help            show this help message and exit\n",
      "  -a ALLC1, --allc1 ALLC1\n",
      "                        first allc.tsv[.gz] file (default: None)\n",
      "  -b ALLC2, --allc2 ALLC2\n",
      "                        second allc.tsv[.gz] file (default: None)\n",
      "  --keep_zero_cov       keep records with cov==0 (default: drop them)\n",
      "                        (default: False)\n",
      "  --dtype {B,H,I,Q,None}\n",
      "                        unsigned-int format to derive mc/cov clamp bound\n",
      "                        (B=255, H=65535, I=2^32-1, Q=2^64-1; None=disable\n",
      "                        clamping; default: B). With B, mc/cov >255 are\n",
      "                        truncated to 255 to mirror how cytozip packs single-\n",
      "                        cell mc/cov as 1-byte B; counts >255 are usually\n",
      "                        repeat-region artifacts and downstream ALLCools DMR\n",
      "                        clips coverage to 50, so this does not affect\n",
      "                        downstream analysis (default: B)\n",
      "  -O OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT\n",
      "                        output TSV of differing rows (default: None)\n",
      "  --sep SEP             column separator of input files (default: )\n"
     ]
    }
